requirements: Retain the exact source revision and native verification evidence.

upgrade: Use the retained immutable image digest in the existing deployment process. Preserve Cloudflare routing and qualify a production-equivalent preview before any origin change.
rollback: Keep the prior immutable image reference and the existing production origin/DNS rollback lane. Change one routing boundary at a time.
knownIssues: This note artifact does not change DNS, production hosting or the upstream simplifaisoul/osiris relationship.
The existing Docker publication workflow remains independent of application validation and production deployment.
